category_seo.title: Product Launch Platforms - Discover & Promote New Products | BiuBiu Tools
category_seo.description: Find the best platforms to launch and discover new products. From Product Hunt to regional platforms like 36Kr and Disquiet.
category_seo.keywords: product hunt, product launch, startup, indie hackers, beta list, product discovery

faqs.question: What is Product Hunt?
faqs.answer: Product Hunt is the leading platform for discovering and launching new tech products. Makers can showcase their products to a community of early adopters, investors, and tech enthusiasts.

faqs.question: When is the best time to launch on Product Hunt?
faqs.answer: Launch at 12:01 AM PST (San Francisco time) to maximize exposure. Tuesdays and Wednesdays typically see more engagement. Avoid weekends and holidays.

faqs.question: What are alternatives to Product Hunt?
faqs.answer: Alternatives include Hacker News (Show HN), BetaList for early-stage startups, Indie Hackers for bootstrapped products, and regional platforms like 36Kr (China), Disquiet (Korea), and EU-Startups (Europe).

faqs.question: How do I promote a Web3 product?
faqs.answer: For Web3 products, use Crypto Twitter, Farcaster, Mirror for content, and platforms like Galxe and Zealy for community campaigns. Also list on DappRadar and ICO Drops for visibility.
